task_title: Place quest log below minimap and toggle quest arrows

plan_review.notes: Resolved reviewer concerns: retain tracked as the single expanded quest and add separate showArrow state; ensure every arrow-producing quest is within the existing MAX_ACTIVE_QUESTS surfaced tracker subset; label the per-row action as navigation arrow ON/OFF and limit it to waypoint output; use existing family avoidance by passing the live quest bounds and sync tracker before family so the family panel relocates when needed; verify actual row hitboxes through the MainGameScene probe.

independent_grade.notes: The diff correctly separates quest arrow visibility from tracked focus, routes HUD clicks through the scene input pipeline, docks the tracker below the minimap, and keeps family-panel avoidance wired to live tracker bounds. The HudQuestTracker sync() stale-toggle fix is correct: truncated quest ids are hidden and excluded from the final visibility re-show loop, so truncated toggles do not remain visible or interactive. Coverage exercises core toggling, waypoint filtering, real-scene click behavior, minimap/main arrows, and layout; it is strong, though the truncation-specific stale-toggle regression is not directly covered.
